about.title: About
about.privacy: Mahlzeit runs on your own server. Your data stays there; nothing is sent to an AI provider unless you switch that on.
about.attribution: Food data sources are named here once the catalogue is added.
about.bls: Generic foods: German Nutrient Database (BLS) 4.0, Max Rubner-Institut, licensed CC BY 4.0. Values per 100 g, selected and rounded by Mahlzeit.
about.off: Packaged foods: Open Food Facts, licensed ODbL. Imported products are checked and saved by you.

connector.title: Claude connector
connector.intro: A personal link that lets Claude read and log food for you. Anyone with the link can act as you, so keep it private.
connector.onceOnly: Copy this link now. It is shown only once.
connector.step1: In Claude, open Settings, then Connectors, and choose "Add custom connector".
connector.step2: Paste the link as the server URL and give it a name, for example Mahlzeit.
connector.step3: In a chat, enable the connector and ask, for example: "Log 200 g skyr for breakfast".
